fields.Name: IT36 - API Scope Enforcement
fields.Description: API-key scope enforcement at the engine: deny-beats-allow at equal priority, app-ceiling caps key scopes, app-binding refusal precedes ceiling, unscoped-key default deny via GetAPIKeyEngine, full_access is an ordinary engine scope (god-mode lives only in ResolverBase). 5 checks (SE1-SE5), self-cleaning minted keys/scopes/bindings.
